ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the name of the flower shape type that has a round cluster of leaves?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows examples of multiple flower forms, with letter labels beside each example. The E example in the lower middle on the right side appears as a compact, approximately circular cluster-like structure, with many overlapping leaves or petals arranged around the center. Reasoning: The question asks “what is the flower form type with a cluster of round leaves called,” and the one in the figure that matches this feature of round clustered leaves is E. According to the plant morphology name, this shape that is like a small rose with leaves radiating and arranged into a round cluster is called rosette.
